home.title: AI Assistant for Academic Literature Review
home.subtitle: A comprehensive solution to help you search, automatically screen, and synthesize information from reputable academic sources.
home.features_subtitle: Powerful tools to optimize your research workflow
home.feature1_desc: Quickly search on Google Scholar. Automatically extract abstracts and assess reliability.
home.feature2_desc: Evaluate the relevance of papers based on your predefined criteria.
home.feature3_desc: Manage your paper library and automatically export important information in standard formats.
home.step1_desc: Advise on research question scope, automatically suggest PRISMA standard inclusion/exclusion criteria.
home.step2_desc: Search across multi-academic sources, automatically filter duplicates, and rank papers by citation credibility.
home.step3_desc: Analyze full text, evaluate relevance, and build a methodology comparison synthesis matrix.
home.step4_desc: Detect Research Gaps, synthesize initial data, and publish a complete Literature Review draft.
home.hero_desc: Empower researchers and students by liberating them from weeks of manual reading. Automate the pipeline from searching and PRISMA screening to discovering research gaps and building comparison matrices.
home.card1_desc: Researchers and university students often spend weeks just performing literature reviews and initial data processing. Repetitive manual searching and filtering lead to easily missing core citation sources.
home.card1_footer: Challenge: Time-consuming & risk of missing literature
home.card2_desc: Build an AI assistant that supports the full pipeline: Search, PRISMA screening, summarization, topic synthesis, Gap Discovery, comparison matrix generation, and preliminary data analysis.
home.card3_list1: Anti-hallucination: 100% of claims must be anchored to real papers with DOI citations.
home.card3_list2: Human-in-the-Loop (HITL): Researchers review, approve, and take responsibility for the final content.
home.card3_list3: Transparency & Warnings: Alerts on limitations when data is lacking and optimizes processing costs for long texts.
home.matrix_title: Build Methodology Comparison Matrix & Discover Research Gaps
home.matrix_desc: The system automatically analyzes the data matrix: Compares algorithms, empirical datasets, evaluation results across studies, and points out bottlenecks that previous research hasn't solved.
home.workflow_desc: Comprehensive support from ideation and screening to finalizing the review report.
home.hitl_title: Every Claim Anchored to Original Text — Final Human Approval
home.hitl_desc: Say no to information hallucination. Every citation has a direct verification link. Researchers maintain full control, refining and approving at each gate before finalizing the draft.

tour.step1_desc: Manage your entire systematic literature review process by individual research projects. Seamlessly switch projects or initiate new topics.
tour.step2_desc: The sidebar guides you through a closed-loop pipeline: PICO Setup (Step 1) → Search & Scopus Matching (Step 2) → Matrix & Grounded RAG (Step 3) → BibTeX Export (Step 4).
tour.step3_desc: AI automatically decomposes your research question into 4 axes (Population, Intervention, Comparison, Outcome) and suggests PRISMA-compliant Inclusion/Exclusion criteria.
tour.step4_desc: Search hundreds of papers on Google Scholar. The engine verifies citation metrics, SCImago/Scopus quartiles (Q1-Q4), and deduplicates records automatically.
tour.step5_desc: Read full-text PDFs side-by-side, extract methodology comparison matrices, and query the AI assistant with 100% DOI-anchored quotes and page citations.
tour.step6_desc: Export comprehensive citation bundles for LaTeX/Overleaf (.bib), comparative spreadsheets (CSV), or a full structured literature review draft.
